_comment: ILM policy for the business data stream `datalake-events`. CDC §7.4.
No warm phase, and a 365-day retention: this is the analytical copy of the
datalake, queried across arbitrary time ranges by the Grafana dashboards,
so there is no cold tail that can be de-prioritised. A forcemerge would
also fight the continuous ingestion from demo-producer.
Rollover is size-driven at 20 GB (larger than the logs: the documents are
small and uniform, so bigger shards stay efficient) with a 7-day ceiling.
